def evolved_p94(x, N, rank, world_size, num_devices,
                 cores_per_device, xm, torch, num_nodes=1):
    # Formula: x[i, j] = min(i, j) * max(i, j) + (i - j) ** 2
    # min(i,j)*max(i,j) == i*j, so x[i,j] = i*j + (i-j)**2
    idx = torch.arange(N, device=x.device).to(x.dtype)
    ii = idx.view(N, 1)
    jj = idx.view(1, N)
    diff = ii - jj
    result = ii * jj + diff * diff
    return result.contiguous().to(x.dtype)
